items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I also brought a handmade guitar by a wonderful maker in California named Jim Mapson

ctx.x: Well I brought to the concert tonight I brought two instruments. It’s funny because I was just listening to a couple of recordings coming up and for a long, for many years I played an Ibenez style Les Paul, then I switched to a Roger Sedowski telecaster style instrument,

which is on a lot of those recordings, which is a wonderful instrument. And then I switched more recently to a guitar made by a company called Brian Moore. It’s called Brian Moore Custom Guitars. It’s not custom made for me, but it’s like a Les Paul with a switch for the guitar guys, a five way switch that you could move it and split the pick-ups and make it sound like single coil pick-ups if you want. It’s got a beefy, fat sound. It’s got a nice bridge pick-up and also under the bridge it has a piezo pick-up,…
